title_zh: 索取迁移史研究机构的档案访问指南

scenario.label_zh: 查询迁移史口述档案的访问方式
scenario.goal_zh: 确认研究机构有相关口述档案并请求访问指南，决定阅读使用条件后再预约

context_zh: 学生联系虚构的海事研究机构，为迁移史课程查找口述史材料。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Is this the Maritime Institute? I'm looking for interviews about immigration through the old port.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: Yes. We have a recorded-history collection, but it isn't available for casual browsing in the lobby.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I thought the building was a museum. Is it a different kind of institution?

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: We're a research centre. Students can request access, subject to the conditions for each recording.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Could you send me the access guide? I need to know whether I can quote the interviews in a class presentation.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: Certainly. It explains the appointment process and which uses require permission.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I'll read that first and then ask about a visit. I won't assume every recording can be quoted.
